issues.title: One-mixture water-filling was phrased as if it solved the general multi-mixture surrogate
issues.diagnosis: Eq. (WS) has min_n max_{w in W}, whereas a single binding mixture's water-filling formula generally does not solve the multi-mixture optimum, whose active mixture combination is represented by the dual variable mu.
issues.required_action: Label the closed form as the W={w} one-mixture subproblem only and explicitly introduce the subsequent dual as the general multi-mixture calculation.
issues.verification_test: The text must state that the preceding formula does not solve general W by choosing an arbitrary binding mixture; C04 must preserve this separation.
issues.evidence_required: Formal scope correction only; no new experiment.
issues.status: resolved_revision_01_2; one-mixture formula and multi-mixture dual separated, then rebuilt
